Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet of a headless FEMALE BODY for a cute Japanese manga publishing office management game. Landscape1536x1024, regular4columns by2rows, EXACTLY8 full-body frames. Each within384x512 cell with30px transparent margins. All same body proportions, camera view and outfit; short chibi body abouthalf full character height, head not present. Small short peach neck stump at top for head attachment. Feminine gentle silhouette: moderate narrow shoulders, natural waist, nonsexualized ordinary adult workwear. Every torso, knees and toes consistently faces THREE-QUARTER TOWARD IMAGE-RIGHT (nose would point right, chest and front of knees to right). Deep chocolate outlines, tidy pixel-art blocks, warm peach hands, navy lower garment or stockings, brown shoes. ALL main upper garment areas bright magenta #b63e83 for runtime recoloring. Keep secondary cream shirt details, navy lower garments, brown shoes neutral. No skin-colored or magenta background. True transparent background, no scenery/chairs/desks/shadows/text. Outfit: relaxed magenta blouse with cream small collar, navy straight tapered trousers, practical brown low flat shoes. Slightly feminine blouse tailoring, no skirt..
Eight poses in reading order: 0 standing idle arms relaxed; 1 walk right with near leg forward and far leg back; 2 walk passing with near foot under body and far knee raising; 3 walk opposite contact with far leg forward near leg back; 4 opposite passing knee pose; 5 sitting and drawing on a small cream manuscript pad held at waist, subtle writing hand position; 6 same seated work pose with a clearly different writing wrist/hand position; 7 happy celebration, both hands raised in small fists by shoulders. Poses5/6 have bent seated knees, feet resting below, no chair. Show all shoes fully. Same rightward facing direction in ALL frames, no reversed body view. Neck center stays near center of each cell. Necks small narrow and short, not flared wide triangles. Do not add heads/hair/faces. Keep style consistent with cozy charming super-deformed pixel office workers, not photorealistic. Separate each frame clearly, no overlap.
